correctness.rationale: Under J(n,2)=L(K_n), a selected edge set is totally dominating iff the support has >=n-1 base vertices and it has no connected component K2. For each nontrivial component v>=3, e>=v-1>=2 implies v<=3e/2, giving h>=ceil(2(n-1)/3). Equality attainments are supplied. For a minimizer H, with s=n-epsilon, c nontrivial components and cyclomatic excess mu>=0, c=s-h+mu<=floor(s/3). Checking n=3k,3k+1,3k+2 shows mu=0, forces s and component-size excess; thus P3 blocks plus at most two order-4 trees or one order-5 tree, with at most one isolated vertex as asserted. Cayley counts 3,16,125 trees per labelled sets and partition factors 1/(2^k k!) lead to given formulas. Independent direct adjacency brute-force of all minimum-edge subsets at n=4..7 gives T=12,80,840,630, matching formulas. Universal forest classification is an analytic combinatorial proof, not the limited enumeration.
